Modbus.Title: SolarEdge Inverter v2 (LifeLogic) - Gorse Labs edition
Modbus.Comment: Original by Jonathan Dixon and Lifestyle Logic Limited, https://gitlab.com/joth/loxonetemplates, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes by Gorse Labs: added plain-English comments and hint texts only. Registers, data types, scaling and polling are unchanged.
Modbus.HintText: Modbus TCP. Use with the logic in SolarEdge_Example.Loxone from the original repository: raw *_combined values must be split and scaled there to avoid spikes.

ModbusCmd.Title: M_Exported_Energy
ModbusCmd.Comment: Meter: total energy exported to grid (raw)
ModbusCmd.HintText: Polled every 30 s. Multiply by 10^M_Energy_SF, and only accept a new value after the 12 s settle delay in the example logic.

ModbusCmd.Title: M_Imported_Energy
ModbusCmd.Comment: Meter: total energy imported from grid (raw)
ModbusCmd.HintText: Polled every 30 s. Multiply by 10^M_Energy_SF, and only accept a new value after the 12 s settle delay in the example logic.

ModbusCmd.Title: B1_Instantaneous_Power
ModbusCmd.HintText: Already scaled to kW. Sign is inverted by the scaling so charging and discharging read the right way round.

ModbusCmd.Title: M_Energy_SF
ModbusCmd.Comment: Meter: scale factor for the energy counters
ModbusCmd.HintText: Power-of-ten exponent. Polled every 8 s, faster than the counters, so a change is seen before it is applied.

ModbusCmd.Title: I_DC_Power_combined
ModbusCmd.Comment: Inverter: DC (PV) power and its scale factor, read together
ModbusCmd.HintText: Raw combined value. Split into value and scale factor in logic, as in the example project.

ModbusCmd.Title: M_AC_Power_combined
ModbusCmd.Comment: Meter: grid power for 3 phases plus scale factor, read as one 64-bit value
ModbusCmd.HintText: Polled every 1 s. One atomic read, so a scale change cannot cause a spike. Split and scale in logic, as in the example project.

ModbusCmd.Title: I_AC_Power_combined
ModbusCmd.Comment: Inverter: AC output power and its scale factor, read together
ModbusCmd.HintText: Raw combined value. Split into value and scale factor in logic, as in the example project.
